MIND. [1] [Aur. m.]
Functions of mind in best order and clear in his views, except with regard to his health or disease ; he imagines he has all possible diseases. θ Angina pectoris.
If left alone he thinks about nothing but his ailments, and gets more and more out of humor ; desires company. θ Angina pectoris.
Inclined to suicide ; frequent weeping ; aversion to occupation.
Laziness. θ Albuminuria.
Great depression of mind. θ Dropsy.
Sadness, as when homesick ; sad, as though a great misfortune impended.
Melancholic mood. θ Ozæna syphilitica.
Profound melancholy. θ Dropsy.
Full of whims and notions.
Insurmountable mental or bodily restlessness ; he has to spend hours in street and in open air. θ Angina pectoris.
Thinking about his disease brings on palpitation. θ Angina pectoris.
After fright or vexation, palpitation, which he can feel and hear. θ Angina pectoris.
Ailments from violent chagrin.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Aur. m.]
Dulness of head. θ Albuminuria.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Aur. m.]
Dull frontal headache.
Drawing in left half of head.
Constant burning in whole head ; < on left side.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Aur. m.]
Head hot ; limbs cool. θ Albuminuria.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Aur. m.]
Amaurosis.
Sclerotica red, with sensation of burning heat and prickling.
Keratitis parenchymatosa ; cornea very opaque, traversed by a dense mass of bloodvessels in cornea, tending towards staphyloma ; ciliary injection, some photophobia, no vision.
Acute ophthalmia. θ Caries of nasal bones.
Chronic inflammation of edges of eyelids.
Fistula lachrymalis.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Aur. m.]
Buzzing in left ear and sensitiveness.
Music relieves.
Ears reddened. θ Angina pectoris.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Aur. m.]
Pressing pain in nose.
Blows blood from nose.
Coryza.
Snuffles of a baby.
Bad smelling, watery discharge, irritating upper lip.
Discharge from nose containing some blood at times. θ Dropsy.
Ozæna scrofulosa, with unbearable odor.
Sudden running of pus from nose. θ Ozæna syphilitica.
Nostrils stuffed up with hard crusts. θ Syphilitic ozæna.
Red swelling of left side of nose ; nasal cavity ulcerated deep in, with dry, yellowish scurf and sense of obstruction, although enough air passes.
Hardness around corners of nose and lips. θ Ozæna.
Deep cracks in alæ nasi ; in old cases of ozæna.
Lupus attacking alæ nasi.
Infant's nose dented in.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Aur. m.]
Red face. θ Angina pectoris.
Pale face with red spots.
Face pale ; limbs cold ; sudden blindness. θ In childbed.
Burning in face at times, mostly after shaving, with a dark redness of cheeks.
Acne rosacea.
Infant with ancient appearance.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Aur. m.]
Caries of lower jaw since scarlatina in second year of her age ; æt. 18.
Exostosis of right cheek bone disappeared in two months after treatment.
Lips swollen, they burn and itch.
Cancerous ulcers on lips.
Lips deep red. θ Angina pectoris.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Aur. m.]
Loose teeth.
Dental fistula.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Aur. m.]
Taste entirely lost. θ Cancer.
Tongue as hard as leather, hardly movable.
Induration remaining after glossitis.
Cancer on tongue.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Aur. m.]
Mucus in morning passes from head to throat. θ Ozæna.
Inflammation with hoarseness.
Suppurating ulcer on tonsils with loss of substance.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Aur. m.]
Diarrhœa after eating.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Aur. m.]
Vomiting of a green fluid. θ Albuminuria.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Aur. m.]
Burning, cutting, stitching in stomach. θ Cardialgia.
Cramps in stomach.
Inflammation of stomach.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Aur. m.]
Induration of liver with dropsy.
Burning in right hypochondrium ; constant disagreeable feeling ; hepatic hyperemia and swelling. θ Ascites.
Spleen enlarged. θ Albuminuria.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Aur. m.]
Pain in bowels. θ Albuminuria.
Distension of single places in abdomen.
Ascites. θ Liver affections. θ Albuminuria.
Stiffness in region of the groins.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Aur. m.]
Diarrhœa. θ Albuminuria.
Hemorrhoidal tumors ; blood discharged during stool.
Excrescences near anus, with an abundant serous discharge.
Anal and intercrural excoriation in a baby.
Numerous circumanal condylomata, in a scrofulous, syphilitic baby.
Fistula in ano of five months' standing, in a young man, æt. 21, bilious, sanguine temperament.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Aur. m.]
Scanty urine. θ Anasarca.
Frequent urging to urinate ; < at night. θ Albuminuria.
Incontinence of urine ; < at night. θ Old man, after dropsy.
Burning on urinating ; urine feels as if too hot ; tenesmus vesicæ.
Urine turbid. θ Dropsy.
Increased discharge of urine ; urine has a peculiar odor and sediment.
Pressing around waist ; increased urine ; renal hyperemia. θ Heart disease. θ Morbus Brightii.
Pains in region of kidneys ; urine pale, clear. θ Albuminuria in pregnancy.
Syphilitic gonorrhœa.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Aur. m.]
Chancre-like ulcers.
Chancres on prepuce and scrotum.
Bubo in left groin.
Excrescences on scrotum. θ Fistula in ano.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Aur. m.]
Painful induration of mouth of uterus.
Metritis.
Catamenia suppressed. θ Dropsy.
Leucorrhœa, light yellow, especially mornings ; uterus prolapsed, indurated ; chronic metritis, with mal-position and discharge.
Pudenda oversensitive.
Burning, itching of vulva.
Heat and itching in vagina.
Gonorrhœal discharge and swelling of both groins.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Aur. m.]
Hoarseness, with violent fever and pleuritic symptoms.
Hoarseness, with inflammation of throat.
Chronic irritation of air passages.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Aur. m.]
Anxious contraction of chest.
Long-lasting asthmatic symptoms.
Anxious abdominal respiration ; labored breathing. θ Anasarca.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Aur. m.]
Pressure under sternum ; palpitation increases with every step, as if chest would burst. θ Hyperemia from stenocardia.
Pulmonary catarrh.
Stitches under ribs and other signs of pleurisy.
Pains in left side of chest, as in pleurisy ; they change place and sometimes leave.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Aur. m.]
Cardiac anguish. θ Endocarditis.
Angina pectoris (next to Arnic. indispensable).
Endocarditis rheumatica.
Heart disease accompanying carious affections of bones.
Beating of heart causes anxiety and sleeplessness, cannot rest until heart is quiet. θ Angina pectoris.
Heartbeats irregular, with severe constriction of chest. θ Rheumatism, after disappearance of swelling of joints.
Heartbeats sharp and metallic, but no other abnormal sound. θ Angina pectoris.
Violent, irregular palpitation, with great oppression of heart. θ Endocarditis.
Pulse large. θ Angina pectoris.
Pulse small and frequent. θ Dropsy.
Heart's beat weak ; apex felt indistinctly. θ Stenocardia.
Weak pulse and feeble heart. θ Dropsy.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Aur. m.]
Hard swelling had twisted neck to right shoulder. θ After scarlatina ; 2[c].
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Aur. m.]
Tearing in left shoulder ; in right arm, from elbow to tip of little finger.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Aur. m.]
Exostoses, with bone pain in both shin bones. θ Secondary syphilis.
Right tibia, anterior aspect of bone denuded and black nearly its entire length, surrounding soft parts inflamed and swollen ; with a boy, æt. 12, exfoliating and healing within six months. θ Necrosis.
Legs swollen and very tender along inside of tibia.
Left leg œdematously swollen.
Infiltration of cellular tissue of legs ; great tension, pain. θ Childbed.
Deep-seated, troublesome pain in left foot. θ After typhus.
Periostitis of left foot. θ After typhus. θ After mechanical injury.
Redness and swelling of toes, with burning and stinging ; cannot put feet down.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Aur. m.]
Limbs cold, covered with sweat. θ After scarlatina.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Aur. m.]
Ascending a hill or stairs causes palpitation and dyspnœa. θ Stenocardia.
Great restlessness ; changes his position every moment ; his friends call him "the quicksilver man." θ Neurosis cordis.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Aur. m.]
Sleepy by day even at work.
Comatose sleep. θ Albuminuria.
Sleepless : from excitement ; from palpitation.
   

FEVER. [40] [Aur. m.]
Violent chill and fever.
Hectic fever : dropsy ; after scarlatina ; secondary syphilis.
Copious cold sweat. θ After scarlatina.
Dryness : in throat.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Aur. m.]
Hyperemia from overaction of heart ; consequent congestion of liver, kidneys, genitals.
Violent rheumatic fever, with painful swelling of joints ; leaving joints and attacking heart.
Dropsies : from heart disease ; from liver affections ; with albuminuria ; after scarlatina ; with intermittent fever.
Swellings characterized by heat, hardness, tension, etc. ; sensitiveness to touch ; < at night, disturbing sleep.
Indurations. See Nose, Lips, Teeth, Uterus, etc.
Cancerous glands.
Bones : periosteum affected ; exostoses ; caries, especially after abuse of mercury ; syphilitic caries.
Caries of joints, with gnawing, boring deep in.
Ascites.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Aur. m.]
Cured ascites even after three successive tappings.
   

SKIN. [46] [Aur. m.]
Eczema.
Skin dry and shrunken. θ Dropsy. θ Albuminuria.
Whole body covered with ulcers and scurf, with hectic fever. θ Secondary syphilis.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Aur. m.]
Girl, æt. 12, with hypertrophy of heart, with dilatation and insufficiency of valves. θ Hydropsia.
Woman, æt. 24, lymphatic constitution, scrofulous habit. θ Hydropsia.
Man, æt. 32, sanguine ; robust. θ Secondary syphilis.
Woman, æt. 40, after rheumatism and endocarditis, fatty degeneration. θ Stenocardia.
A man, æt. 57, well-preserved, lively temperament, had gonorrhœa. θ Angina pectoris.
After syphilis, maltreated by mercury. θ Osteocopus.
Mercurial affections.
A stout young man, subject to rheumatic attacks. θ Endocarditis.
